summary: testSwitchingPendingChangesProjectsClearsPriorSummaryBeforeLoading exercises the real DiffModel.refresh(projectPath:) (unmocked, real git subprocess) and asserts summary/hasLoadedOnce are synchronously cleared to nil/false the instant a project switch is triggered, directly matching the pane's rendering logic (DiffPaneView shows content only when model.summary != nil); a violating implementation that kept the prior project's summary displayed until the new load completed would fail this assertion, so it is a genuine, non-tautological counterexample-catching test.
